mechanism: Praziquantel induces CYP3A4, reducing atorvastatin plasma concentrations and efficacy; atorvastatin may inhibit praziquantel metabolism via CYP3A4 competition.
action: Monitor lipid levels closely during concurrent use; consider increasing atorvastatin dose or selecting an alternative statin not metabolized by CYP3A4; verify praziquantel efficacy.
